tools.name: create_or_update_file
tools.description: Create or update a single file in a GitLab project

tools.name: get_file_contents
tools.description: Get the contents of a file or directory from a GitLab project

tools.name: push_files
tools.description: Push multiple files to a GitLab project in a single commit

tools.name: create_issue
tools.description: Create a new issue in a GitLab project

tools.name: create_merge_request
tools.description: Create a new merge request in a GitLab project

tools.name: fork_repository
tools.description: Fork a GitLab project to your account or specified namespace

tools.name: create_branch
tools.description: Create a new branch in a GitLab project

create_or_update_file.why: commits a file to any project the caller names; history keeps the old version

search_repositories.why: returns project names and descriptions; private ones the token can see

create_repository.why: creates a project, possibly public, with caller-written text; it can be deleted

get_file_contents.why: returns project content that others wrote; private projects included

push_files.why: pushes a commit to any project the caller names; history keeps the old version

create_issue.why: opens an issue on any project; watchers are notified

create_merge_request.why: opens a merge request; watchers are notified

fork_repository.why: forks a project into the account; the fork can be deleted

create_branch.why: creates a branch on any project the caller names; it can be deleted

rationale: The GitHub server's shape on GitLab: reads content others wrote, sees private projects, publishes to any project.
